verdict.rationale: Rendering performance is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, so the story applies. No item in the pack mentions GPU acceleration, a Metal renderer, or throughput and responsiveness under heavy output. The docs and community items cover panes, hotkeys, search, triggers, tmux, scripting, AI and images, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on GPU-accelerated rendering that stays fast and responsive under heavy output
